response.rationale: Both answers are accurate for the cue. Indonesian tabungan and Malaysian simpanan denote saved money, including bank savings. Simpanan also exists in Indonesian, so the relation is a common-word preference rather than an exclusive distinction; this does not create a learner-critical error. No false-friend contrast is asserted.
